scope: classical finite positive-arity relational extension theory completeness
core_statement: For the extension theory T_ext of finite positive-arity relational vocabularies, any two countable models of T_ext are isomorphic by back-and-forth, hence T_ext is complete.
proof_surface: finite partial isomorphism between finite generated substructures
forward extension uses one-point extension axiom in the target model
backward extension uses the same argument with source and target exchanged
countable enumeration schedules all elements of both countable models
union of the chain is a total isomorphism
countable categoricity implies completeness for the extension theory
boundaries: no Lean-formal T_ext completeness theorem claim
no Lean-formal Fagin theorem closure claim
no claim for vocabularies with functions or constants
